title: C-plane micro-brief: rotations & quota notes
content:
Quick micro-brief from the small rotation this morning — capturing the messy bits while they're fresh. Intended to be short, actionable, and easy to follow for the next oncall shift.

Attendees
- Avery (writer/oncall lead)
- Diego (routing)
- Priya (auth/quotas)
- Samir (allocator)

Meeting context / why this happened- We ran a focused swap of the ambassador routing experiment (canary -> wider) to validate quota fallthrough behavior under mixed-tenancy bursts. Also exercised an auth token rotation path for edge caches (no customer downtime).

Quick snapshot metrics (observed during 08:30–09:15 PDT)- 95th p50 p99 latency (control-plane handshake): 28ms / 42ms / 190ms (brief spikes correlated with allocator GC)- Auth token refresh failures: 18 total, ~70% due to expired HSM connection handshake (see notes)- Route fallthroughs to slow-fallback: 43 requests in 45m, mostly small-tenant traffic during quota peaks- Quota enforcement rejections (429s): 12 unique customers, spike lasted ~6m- KV cache eviction events: multiple short-lived evictions after we toggled prefix caching TTL from 60s->30s

What we changed- Deployed ambassador routing change (ref: PLT-2418) to widen candidate list used for latency-aware routing.- Rolled a non-disruptive auth key refresh to edge caches (staggered across regions).- Temporarily tightened prefix cache TTL for experiment to stress eviction heuristics.

Symptoms observed / anomalies- Unexpected auth handshake timeouts in eu-west-1: traced to HSM proxy restart during scheduled maintenance; token refresh path didn't retry fast enough (backoff + jitter settings too aggressive).- Allocator GC cycles triggered p99 control-plane spikes — correlated with large ephemeral pool reclamation when ambassador widened candidate set.- Fallback routing metric showed that small tenants were disproportionately routed to slow-fallback when quota caches miss simultaneously.

Immediate remediation taken during the shift- Reverted the cache TTL toggle to 60s (rolled back within 8m).- Temporarily bumped token refresh concurrency for HSM proxy path (Priya pushed config rollout).- Rolled back ambassador candidate widening on the slow-fallback path while we instrument more metrics.

Action items (owner, due)- Priya: open follow-up to relax HSM backoff pattern and add faster jitter (Linear PLT-2430) — due 2027-04-16.- Diego: add per-tenant fallback scorecard and a small-tenant weighting fix in routing policy to avoid over-eager fallthroughs (PLT-2441) — due 2027-04-20.- Samir: investigate allocator GC pacing and add smoothing to ephemeral reclamation (GH issue: controlplane#679) — due 2027-04-18.- Avery: add a small synthetic scenario in staging that mirrors today’s mixed-tenancy burst, include quota and routing telemetry — due 2027-04-15.

Open questions / things to validate- Is HSM proxy maintenance window being scheduled without notifying the oncall automation? Need a cross-team look.- Do we want a separate quota cache path for low-volume tenants to avoid them getting deprioritized during tight caching windows?- Can we add an adaptive TTL for prefix cache that lengthens under eviction storms?

Notes to the next rotation- If you see auth refresh spikes in eu-west-1: check HSM proxy logs first, then the HSM circuit breaker counter. Priya has a short runbook entry on Slack.- If p99 latency spikes coincide with allocator GC: temporarily bump the allocator soft-limit while Samir investigates.- Watch the small-tenant fallback ratio dashboard (dash: ControlPlane / Routing / Small-Tenant-Fallback). If ratio > 15% for >10m, escalate to routing oncall.

Decisions made- Rollback ambassador widening on slow-fallback route (till routing team lands scoring tweak).- Keep global prefix TTL at 60s for now; revisit with adaptive TTL POC.

Misc notes / brainstorming fragments (informal)- Could we introduce a micro-cache for quota tokens specifically for low-volume tenants (cheap in-memory store on edge nodes)?- Consider a short-term hack: mark requests from low-volume tenants with a slightly higher routing priority during TTL storms. Cheap but needs careful opt-in.

Relevant links + logs- Linear: PLT-2418, PLT-2430, PLT-2441- GH: controlplane PR#678, issue#679- Slack: #platform-controlplane thread starting 2027-04-13 08:28

Follow-up sync planned- Quick async update in #platform-controlplane by EOD 2027-04-13. Mini deep-dive with routing + allocator next Tues 2027-04-19 09:00 PDT.

Timestamped raw notes (for traceability)
- 08:28: canary -> widened candidates applied (diego)
- 08:32: first p99 spike; correlate with allocator logs
- 08:37: auth refresh failures begin, eu-west-1 (priya)
- 08:40: TTL toggle experiment started (avery)
- 08:44: evictions increase; rollback TTL (avery)
- 08:53: ambassador widening rollback (diego)
- 09:05: remediation steps validated; reduced error rates

If anything in here is unclear ping me or drop quick notes in the thread. This doc intentionally terse — meant for the next rotation to pick up and run.

-- Avery
